thread:
jamie: FYI customer on v0.12.3 ios-sdk hit 400 when calling tool 'pdf-extract'. They pasted JSON into app and got 'schema validation failed: unexpected control character (0x09) at pos 34'.

maria: any logs? :eyes:

jamie: logs from proxy:
```
400 Bad Request - invalid JSON: unexpected '\t' in string at char 34
Content-Length: 712
```

ingrid: repro steps?

jamie: steps:
1) open app
2) paste this arg into tool call input:
```
{"file_path": "/uploads/report.pdf", "notes": "First line\tSecond column\nFinal"}
```
Note the paste contains a literal tab (\t) from clipboard, not escaped. On iOS webview it becomes a literal tab char in the string field.

maria: hmm the SDK should escape control chars. Which encoder? objc JSONSerialization??

jamie: they use JSONSerialization on Swift, but the field is user-typed into a raw string input and then wrapped at the client into a tool args blob without escaping. Our server expects tool args to be JSON string with escaped control chars. If literal tab present, our server's strict parser rejects.

ingrid: can we fallback to tolerant parser and normalize? Risks XSS? maybe not. But quick fix support-side: preflight sanitizer to replace U+0009..U+000D with escapes.

maria: agree. For immediate customer fix, ask them to update SDK to call `jsonData = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: args, options: [])` instead of manual string concat. Also customer can strip tabs before sending.

jamie: I'll escalate to eng-infra, attaching sample payload and failing request-id 01F8Z9.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2045 - toolcall-raw-control-char-reject

ingrid: create a small patch on the parsing layer to run a quick pre-parse replace `s/[\u0000-\u001F]/\u00XX/` and log sanitized payloads.

maria: add a unit test for literal tab and form-data boundary behavior. Also notify mobile SDK owners.

jamie: pinging @mobile-sdk and @support-suspenders, sending repro package.

maria: Thanks. I'll own the rollback plan if sanitizer causes regressions. :+1:
